moral_character_required.quote: showing to the board's satisfaction that the applicant is of good moral character

accrediting_body.value: recognized national accrediting organization approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: accreditation by a recognized national accrediting organization approved by the board

required.quote: Applicants graduating after 1990 from a podiatric medical school shall present evidence of successful completion of a residency program approved by a national accrediting podiatric medicine organization.

kind.quote: successful completion of a residency program approved by a national accrediting podiatric medicine organization

interval_years.quote: Every podiatrist licensed to practice in this state shall obtain 40 clock hours of continuing education in each two-year cycle of license renewal.

required.quote: Every podiatrist licensed to practice in this state shall obtain 40 clock hours of continuing education in each two-year cycle of license renewal.

hours_per_period.quote: shall obtain 40 clock hours of continuing education in each two-year cycle of license renewal

period_years.quote: 40 clock hours of continuing education in each two-year cycle of license renewal

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice podiatric medicine to any person currently or formerly licensed to practice podiatric medicine in another state who satisfies the requirements of this section

requirements.value: Must satisfy all standard licensure requirements, present evidence of license status in all prior states, disclose disciplinary history, submit professional liability insurer information and malpractice settlements for the preceding five years, and provide evidence of continuing education compliance.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall satisfy the requirements established in subdivision 1. The applicant shall present evidence satisfactory to the board indicating the current status of a license to practice podiatric medicine issued by the first state of licensure and all other states and countries

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person not holding a valid license or permit issued in accordance with this chapter to practice podiatric medicine

title_protection.quote: use in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, or soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity, the designation "doctor of podiatric medicine," "podiatrist," "DPM," "podiatric physician," "chiropodist," "foot specialist," or "foot doctor"

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person not holding a valid license or permit issued in accordance with this chapter to practice podiatric medicine as defined in section 153.01, subdivision 2, in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for a license contained in this chapter or rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by fraud, cheating, or attempting to subvert the licensing examination process
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a license by fraud or cheating or attempting to subvert the licensing examination process

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction within the previous five years of a felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction, during the previous five years, of a felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against the podiatric license in another state or jurisdiction, or failure to report such charges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation, suspension, restriction, limitation, or other disciplinary action against the person's podiatric medical license in another state or jurisdiction, failure to report to the board that charges regarding the person's license have been brought in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false or misleading
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertising that is false or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule or order of the board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of podiatric medicine or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating a rule adopted by the board or an order of the board, a state, or federal law that relates to the practice of podiatric medicine, or in part regulates the practice of podiatric medicine, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unethical conduct, conduct likely to deceive or harm the public, or professionally incompetent practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in any unethical conduct; conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public, or demonstrating a willful or careless disregard for the health, welfare, or safety of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise a preceptor, resident, or other graduate trainee or undergraduate student
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to supervise a preceptor, resident, or other graduate trainee or undergraduate student

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in the practice of podiatric medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, dangerous to the public, or sexually dangerous by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: adjudication as mentally incompetent, or a person who is mentally ill, or as a chemically dependent person, a person dangerous to the public, a sexually dangerous person, or a person who has a sexual psychopathic personality by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct departing from minimal standards of acceptable podiatric medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in unprofessional conduct that includes any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatric medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use disorder, or mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or substance use disorder or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when required or permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when otherwise required or permitted by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper management of medical records, including failure to maintain adequate records or comply with patient requests
disciplinary_grounds.quote: improper management of medical records, including failure to maintain adequate medical records, to comply with a patient's request made under sections 144.291 to 144.298 or to furnish a medical record or report required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, paying, or promising to pay a part of a fee in exchange for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting, paying, or promising to pay a part of a fee in exchange for patient referrals

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices, including violations of Medicare, Medicaid, or state medical assistance laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices, including violations of the federal Medicare and Medicaid laws or state medical assistance laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming addicted or habituated to a drug or intoxicant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: becoming addicted or habituated to a drug or intoxicant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic, experimental, or investigative purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic or experimental or investigative purposes authorized by a state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual conduct with a patient or verbal behavior that is seductive or sexually demeaning
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in sexual conduct with a patient or conduct that may reasonably be interpreted by the patient as sexual, or in verbal behavior which is seductive or sexually demeaning to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make required reports or to cooperate with a board investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to make reports as required by section 153.24 or to cooperate with an investigation of the board as required by section 153.20

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing false or misleading information directly related to the care of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly providing false or misleading information that is directly related to the care of that patient unless done for an accepted therapeutic purpose such as the administration of a placebo

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, and the soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, and the soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, and the soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe or administer any drugs or medications necessary or helpful to the practice of podiatric medicine
drug_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the prescribing or administering of any drugs or medications necessary or helpful to the practice of podiatric medicine as defined by this subdivision.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, and the soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity

amputation_authorized.quote: Medical or surgical treatment includes partial foot amputation and excludes amputation of the hand or fingers.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Use of local anesthetics is within the scope of medical and surgical management in patient care. Use of anesthetics, other than local, is excluded, except as provided in section 153.26.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, mechanical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human hand, foot, ankle, and the soft tissue of the lower leg distal to the tibial tuberosity

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: it is not a violation of this clause for a podiatrist to employ, supervise, or delegate functions to a qualified person who may or may not be required to obtain a license or registration to provide health services

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: it is not a violation of this clause for a podiatrist to employ, supervise, or delegate functions to a qualified person who may or may not be required to obtain a license or registration to provide health services if that person is practicing within the scope of that person's license or registration or delegated authority

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the prescribing or recommending of appliances, devices, or shoes for the correction or relief of foot ailments.

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: For a podiatrist who has completed a residency, podiatric medicine includes the performance of all or part of the medical history and physical examination for the purpose of hospital admission for podiatric management or preoperative podiatric surgery.
